data.note: one model coder (Claude, codebook 1.5.0); test-retest is the same model coding twice; descriptive

coders.A: Claude agent in Claude Code (no API cost), same model family as the batch coder (claude-opus-5-5), blind to the batch coding
coders.B: Claude agent in Claude Code (no API cost), same model family as the batch coder (claude-opus-5-5), blind to the batch coding and to A

blind_audit.consensus_rule: consensus = the value A and B both gave; split when they differ

rhetorical_gap.definition: rhetorical_gap = the coder judged its own entry quote a gap statement (Swales move 2: names what is unknown, unclear, debated or lacking). Batch quotes carry no flag; they inherit a coder flag when that coder quoted an overlapping sentence (overlap() rule), and the g21 regex gap marker (MARKERS["gap"]) is given beside them.
